name: Norovirus genome assembly benchmark
description: Compares performance of different genome assembly approaches for norovirus within metagenomic samples, assessing accuracy, completeness, and contiguity of reconstructed genomes.
reputation: A focused research benchmark used by viral genomics and bioinformatics groups; moderately adopted within that community.
notes: Non-LLM bioinformatics benchmark. Outcomes are sensitive to contamination, low viral abundance in metagenomes, choice of ground-truth (synthetic spike-ins vs. real samples), and assembler parameterization; dataset size/domain specificity can limit generalizability.
